A CPython interpreter provided as a pixi-managed conda-forge environment.
The python candy ships a pixi.toml that pins python >=3.13,<3.14 from
conda-forge, and a pixi builder stage materializes the environment at
~/.pixi/envs/default, so the CPython interpreter lands at a fixed,
PATH-contributed path.
The image's environment belongs to whichever candy ships the pixi.toml it
is built from, so a consuming image may legitimately pin a different minor
than this default — open-webui, for one, requires <3.13. The checks
therefore assert what the layer actually guarantees: a working CPython at
or above the supported floor of 3.11, verified by file existence, the
version it reports, and real standard-library code including the sqlite3 C
extension. An image that needs an exact minor asserts it in its own plan.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the pixi-managed CPython interpreter exists at the default environment bin path |
| `check` | the interpreter is a CPython at or above the supported floor (3.11) — the exact minor belongs to whichever candy owns the image's pixi.toml, not to this layer |
| `check` | the interpreter executes a standard-library snippet (incl. the sqlite3 C extension) and satisfies the same floor |
